title: agentic-control: reference implementation of the Agentic Control Architecture
description: Reference implementation of the Agentic Control Architecture v1.0, a control plane for agents acting on enterprise systems under delegated authority: nine components (registry, identity, policy decision, policy enforcement, run coordination, evidence, data boundary, model gateway, operations) with the contracts of the specification's Appendix A, the worked warranty-replacement flow of section 8 as a runnable example, and a conformance suite organised around the nine findings of the specification's verification record. Specification and design rationale included under spec/ (prose: CC0 1.0; code: Apache-2.0).
